title: Classical Greek theater (Aeschylus' Prometheus trilogy) gave rise to geometric and psychological perspective

tellings.quote: it was the first moment in history of recorded history that people were able to take the position of spectators at a theater sitting in different places on different nights.

plain: Classical Greek theatre, and in particular Aeschylus's Prometheus plays, is said to have given humans both geometric perspective and psychological perspective, because for the first time in recorded history people sat as spectators in different seats on different nights and saw the same story from different angles. The philosopher Jason Jorjani makes this argument on the show, drawing on his own book Prometheus and Atlas and on Julian Jaynes's book The Origin of Consciousness in the Breakdown of the Bicameral Mind, as part of a larger idea that human consciousness changed at a datable point.
